description: Canonicalisation and numeric-domain vectors for minitrace-spec v0.3.0 §3.4. Generated by build_canonical_vectors.py; do not edit by hand.

verdicts.canonical: conformant; `canonical` is the RFC 8785 form and `sha256` its digest
verdicts.not-conformant: violates the §3.4 numeric domain or depth limit; `reason` names the rule

vectors.name: baseline_reorder
vectors.note: alphabetic key reorder

vectors.name: e_neg_7
vectors.note: below 1e-6: canonical form uses exponent notation

vectors.name: e_pos_16
vectors.note: 1e16 lies beyond 2^53-1 by value: outside the §3.4 domain whatever its spelling

vectors.name: e_pos_21
vectors.note: 1e21 lies beyond 2^53-1 by value: outside the §3.4 domain (no conformant trace reaches RFC 8785's 1e21 exponent switch)

vectors.name: exponent_uppercase
vectors.note: source notation carries no meaning

vectors.name: bmp_vs_non_bmp_keys
vectors.note: key sort by UTF-16 code units (RFC 8785 §3.2.3): the non-BMP key sorts first

vectors.name: empty_object
vectors.note: empty object

vectors.name: empty_array
vectors.note: empty array

vectors.name: deep_nesting
vectors.note: 8-level object nesting

vectors.name: deep_array
vectors.note: 32-level array nesting

vectors.name: depth_64_array
vectors.note: array nesting at the §3.4 depth limit of 64: conformant

vectors.name: depth_64_object
vectors.note: object nesting at the §3.4 depth limit of 64: conformant

vectors.name: depth_65_array
vectors.note: array nesting one beyond the §3.4 depth limit

vectors.name: non_bmp_string_value
vectors.note: non-BMP character in a value

vectors.name: escape_equiv_literal
vectors.note: literal UTF-8 form of U+1D11E; same canonical bytes as the escaped form

vectors.name: escape_equiv_surrogate
vectors.note: surrogate-pair escape of U+1D11E; same canonical bytes as the literal form

vectors.name: mixed_array
vectors.note: array order preserved

vectors.name: control_chars
vectors.note: C0 escapes: short forms for b t n f r, lowercase \u00xx otherwise (RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2)

vectors.name: large_string
vectors.note: 20 000-character value, no truncation

vectors.name: negative_zero
vectors.note: negative zero canonicalises to 0

vectors.name: negative_zero_float
vectors.note: negative zero in float form canonicalises to 0

vectors.name: max_safe_integer
vectors.note: 2^53-1, the largest admissible integer literal

vectors.name: min_safe_integer
vectors.note: -(2^53-1), the smallest admissible integer literal

vectors.name: bigint_as_string
vectors.note: an out-of-range integer carried as a string, as §3.4 requires

vectors.name: float_form_beyond_safe
vectors.note: float spelling of 2^53+1, binary64 value 9007199254740992: outside the §3.4 domain by value

vectors.name: two_pow_53
vectors.note: 2^53 as an integer literal: outside the range although exactly representable

vectors.name: beyond_safe_integer
vectors.note: 2^53+1 as an integer literal

vectors.name: beyond_safe_integer_negative
vectors.note: -(2^53+1) as an integer literal

vectors.name: nan
vectors.note: NaN is not JSON and not admissible

vectors.name: infinity
vectors.note: Infinity is not JSON and not admissible

vectors.name: negative_infinity
vectors.note: -Infinity is not JSON and not admissible

vectors.name: float_overflow
vectors.note: overflows binary64 to infinity

vectors.name: duplicate_key
vectors.note: two members named x: no single canonical form (one reader keeps the last, another refuses)

vectors.name: duplicate_key_nested
vectors.note: a repeated name in a nested object, even with equal values

vectors.name: lone_high_surrogate
vectors.note: an unpaired high surrogate escape in a value

vectors.name: lone_low_surrogate
vectors.note: an unpaired low surrogate escape in a value

vectors.name: lone_surrogate_member_name
vectors.note: an unpaired surrogate in a member name

vectors.name: noncharacter_fdd0
vectors.note: U+FDD0, the first of the 32 contiguous noncharacters

vectors.name: noncharacter_fffe_literal
vectors.note: U+FFFE as literal UTF-8

vectors.name: noncharacter_plane16
vectors.note: U+10FFFF as a surrogate pair: a noncharacter in plane 16

vectors.name: noncharacter_member_name
vectors.note: U+FDEF, the last contiguous noncharacter, in a member name

vectors.name: noncharacter_neighbours
vectors.note: U+FDCF, U+FDF0, U+FFFD and U+1FFFD sit next to noncharacters and are characters
